versions.changelog:
- Initial release of experience-model-builder.
- Enables extraction of user-provided practices/experiences into structured, reusable models.
- Triggers when users ask to summarize or model an experience (specific trigger phrases).
- Includes clear input collection, validation, model structuring, and output checks.
- Outputs standardized, actionable models in Markdown format with explicit conclusions and strategy suggestions.
- Built-in handling for incomplete/inappropriate input and suitability boundaries.
